source_doc.title: Calcalist: Tower Semiconductor surges to $15 billion valuation — silicon photonics expansion and AI revenue mix
source_doc.permission_basis: Copyrighted news article; only brief quotations for research are stored in library/raw and this extraction.

sources.quote: $300 million expansion of its silicon photonics production lines, on top of a $350 million investment disclosed earlier this year.
Migdal HaEmek, Tower's main manufacturing site in northern Israel, which is set to become the company's largest photonics hub.
expects to triple revenue from photonics-related activity, approaching $1 billion annually from AI-linked products alone.
40% to 45% of Tower's revenue will come from data-center applications.

claims.statement: Tower is investing $300M on top of an earlier $350M to expand silicon photonics production lines, with Migdal HaEmek becoming its largest photonics hub; after the H1 2026 expansion it expects to triple photonics-related revenue, approaching $1B annually from AI-linked products alone (independent Calcalist reporting with CEO interview).
claims.disproof_condition: The expansion is delayed or scaled back, or photonics revenue fails to approach the ~$1B annual run-rate after the expansion completes.

claims.statement: Tower CEO estimates 40-45% of company revenue will come from data-center applications by end of 2026 — the foundry's revenue mix is pivoting to AI/data-center optics.
claims.disproof_condition: Reported segment mix at end-2026 shows data-center applications materially below 40% of revenue.
